column1: Tab 6b — Needs and Demands -> Intervention Route (v3.1)

Some needs are about a task (NUCRIPCE applies); many are about support and need an intervention route with no task at all. The user picks a need in plain language; the backend maps it to one or more of the intervention domains. The band (Tab 10) still decides how that route is delivered - e.g. Execute is capped to Routine in Amber, Reflect is offered in Green, Blue, or Yellow at Mild/Moderate intensity; Meditate follows the MD rules in Tab 6c.

column1: Decision v3.2: Reflect and Meditate (Rituals / Prayer) are CONFIRMED as the 7th and 8th support pathways and are not folded into Regulate, Dump or Express. Regulate changes how you feel right now; Dump offloads without structure; Express shapes words for someone else; Reflect makes meaning for yourself afterwards; Meditate is an intentional practice (stillness, ritual or prayer) chosen by the user. Keeping them separate lets the engine gate each safely (Tab 6c) and measure whether it helps. Status: confirmed by the Product Owner; prompts and faith-related copy need Clinical Safety sign-off.
